description: Fork of NicholasBly/youtube-webos (ad-free YouTube for LG webOS TVs), rebuilt on upstream tag 0.8.5 with the fork's identity and fixes re-applied on top.
divergence: Own README, CHANGELOG, repo.json, icons, version numbering and release/test/update-repo workflows; upstream's discussion workflow, test-build .ipks and build-local*.cmd are removed
pnpm with husky and lint-staged instead of npm

Legacy webOS 3-6 / Chrome 38 build dropped: src/polyfills, emoji-font, hooks/buffer-limit.js, the *-absent.js stubs, legacy tests and their dependencies are gone; legacy-only branches inside shared upstream modules are left as written (see intent.md)
DeArrow and Return YouTube Dislike removed, with their config keys; the settings panel has four tabs (Main, SponsorBlock, Shortcuts, UI Tweaks), so test tab indices differ from upstream
Bundle budget in tests/smoke/bundle-check.cjs lowered to 200 KiB
features/comments-fix.js overrides only the properties the closing rule collapses, per selector of a split list, instead of upstream's all-properties override

features/sponsorblock/overlay.js maps non-highlight segments across chapter gaps with chapterBarRanges; upstream's sibling-overlay positioning is kept; drawOverlay passes the chapter track found from the tracked segment

ui/shortcuts/router.js listens on window capture (YouTube stops trusted colour keys there), skips the mod's own synthetic keys and YouTube's unflagged re-send of them within 100 ms, and on Back dismisses the OLED overlay and swallows the held key until keyup; yellow is a bindable key
Extra shortcut actions seek_fwd/seek_back (10 s) and seek_fwd_ex/seek_back_ex (30 s); bindings.js renames a stored chapter_skip_next to chapter_skip
